title: File:Soldier turning - Tomb of the Unknown Soldier - Arlington National Cemetery - 2012.jpg
author: Tim Evanson
description: Looking south at an honor guard soldier in front of the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier in front of Memorial Amphitheater at Arlington National Cemetery near Washington, D.C., in the United States. The guard has made his turn and is adjusting his rifle so that it rests on the shoulder facing away from the memoria.
